integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic C* actions; projectivity gives ordinary topological Euler characteristic.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: A generic one-parameter subgroup of the vertex diagonal torus has pairwise distinct weights on all arrow matrix coordinates.
integrity.membership_basis: At an arrow-coordinate point the chosen direct arrow has rank one and every composite of length at least two vanishes.
integrity.object_basis: The archival source defines quiver varieties by rank conditions on all composites in a sequence of vector spaces and linear maps.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival source lists Mathematics Subject Classification 14M15 first.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ordinary Euler characteristic and does not determine finer topology, singularities, multidegrees, or Grothendieck classes.
It is stated for equioriented type-A quiver loci; arbitrary orientations are not claimed.
A recent CSM theory for open quiver loci is adjacent and may imply related Euler information after additional work.
title: Euler characteristic of projective type-A quiver loci ignores higher composite ranks
